guard/30347.htm.text: Sentry Marion: I am Sentry Marion who serves the will of Shilen and guards the Dark Elves. Rain or snow, I live by my faith to keep our village safe. However, these days, the monsters that swarm around the Marshlands give me no relief.

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30347-1.htm.text: Sentry Marion: If you go south of here, there is a very large swamp. They say that it was created as a side effect of the black magic used in the war with the Elves.
